title: The Flow of Light
owner_request: Improve fluidity and design, build a repeatable cloud authoring environment, then make the video.
scope: One continuous 12-second solo and fixed-camera proof; original authored choreography, not reference-video motion capture.

source.dirty_during_finishing: Handoff-only Markdown was being written; frozen rendering inputs were verified before and after production.

limitations: Automated checks do not assess anatomy, lettering accuracy, musical intention, or artistic quality.
Brightness and temporal pixel checks are review warnings, not a creative approval or physical camera measurements.
The 10-bit profiles are Rec.709 SDR, not HDR. ProRes range is implicit when ffprobe omits its range flag.

motion.interpretation: Pixel heuristics for review, not measurements of physical camera jerk or proof of natural movement.

saved_blender_export.scope: One unchanged production armature and one deliberate wrist key edit in a separate saved copy; no production bake or costume changes.

cloth.scope: Every saved 30 Hz cloth state, including endpoint interpolation guard; no new simulation.
limitations: The solver has body collision but no cloth self-collision or cloth interaction between performers.
These are geometric checks; continuous native visual review and final encoded review remain separate.

visual_review.method: Dense ordered PNG sequences for movement and sampled decoded final MP4 frames for beauty. No real-time playback claim.

resources.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
resources.setup: Isolated Python3.12 environment with compatible pinned dependency packages copied from existing verified project runtime after offline wheel cache miss. No new subscriptions or paid API calls.
resources.reproduction: uv sync --frozen --extra legacy on a network-enabled Linux environment; Blender4.3.2; ffmpeg; existing project fonts; declared source inputs.

remaining_scope_limits: The performer is an authored stylized solo; a five-person ensemble requires new spacing, roles, timing and interaction work.
Close feet and fan/head overlap reduce support/silhouette readability in parts of the turn and sweep.
Simplified gold face/hands, fitted bodice shading and a small lower-hem light patch remain in sampled beauty frames.
The Blender asset exports body animation. Concert materials, props, scene and native cloth remain in the source renderer.
No cloth self-collision, inter-performer cloth collision, new toe joints or force-based balance simulation are claimed.
